title: Vortex Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Watermelon Ice delivers the delicate sweetness of juicy Watermelon paired with an invigorating menthol finish. This simple yet refreshing flavour is a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy fruity profiles with a frosty twist. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Watermelon Ice offers a balanced combination of smooth vapour and full-bodied flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine absorption, ideal for a satisfying and easy vaping experience. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are available in a 10ml format, providing a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Watermelon Ice is a popular choice for fans of cool and fruity blends.
